title: plugin-approvals: the admin_rescue system comment is written into the approval timeline as English prose, so a zh-CN viewer reads it untranslated
body:
## What happens

On a record's **审批 / Approvals** tab, every timeline entry names the step by a title-cased version of the node id, not by the node's configured label:

```
提交 · Dev Admin · Review Reviewer
通过 · Dev Admin · Review Reviewer
提交 · Dev Admin · Review Director
```

The flow declares Chinese labels for those nodes, and the server already stores them. From `sys_approval_action` for the same request:

```json
{ "step_name": "review_reviewer", "step_label": "初审人审批", "action": "approve", ... }
```

`sys_approval_request.current_step_label` is also `初审人审批`. So the data is right; the console timeline renders `step_name` (humanized) rather than `step_label`.

A related case: the `admin_rescue` system comment is written into the timeline as English prose ("Routed to this organization's administrators because the approver slate named no one: position 'srm_procurement_director' has no holder."). It shows up untranslated on a zh-CN console.

## Repro

- `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0, `objectstack dev`, locale zh-CN.
- App: objectstack-ai/hotsrm `main`, flow `srm_admission_approval`. Its nodes are `review_reviewer` (label `初审人审批`) and `review_director` (label `采购总监审批`).
- Create an application, set its status to `admission_review`, and approve both steps.
- Open the record and go to the 审批 tab.

## Expected

The timeline shows `初审人审批` / `采购总监审批` (`step_label`, or the translated label once #24863's contract applies). System comments use the viewer's locale.

## Related

- #24863 and #24281 (both closed) cover labels in the request snapshot and the highlights strip. This issue is the timeline on the record's Approvals tab.
